items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1961-10-11
items.q: One was Jim Little. Yeah, I heard him too.

ctx.x: One of you, when you were young did you have any other favorite bass players, no doubt your brother and your father, of course I know they were great, but were there any other great players around that you liked?
One was Jim Little. Yeah, I heard him too.
And the other one was Albert Morgan. Oh yes, he's a young fellow though.
